title: Commission invites public to shape new carbon storage certification for buildings
summary: The Commission has opened public feedback until 10 December 2026 on a draft certification methodology under the CRCF Regulation for carbon storage in buildings using bio-based construction materials such as timber. It is the first proposed methodology for carbon storage in products, following methodologies already adopted for permanent carbon removals and carbon farming. The Commission is also assessing applications from nine certification schemes seeking recognition under the regulation.
why_it_matters: Completes the CRCF methodology set and coincides with the recognition of certification schemes, which will also certify permanent removals such as BECCS whose credit revenue underpins Nordic capture-and-storage chains.
